paragraphs.text: When people set out to improve their health, they usually take a familiar path: starting a healthy diet, getting better sleep, and doing regular exercise. Each of these behaviors is important, of course, but they all 26 on physical health—and a growing body of research suggests that social health is just as, if not more, important to 27 well-being.

sentences.text: When people set out to improve their health, they usually take a familiar path: starting a healthy diet, getting better sleep, and doing regular exercise.

analysis.translationLiteral: 当人们着手改善健康时，通常走一条熟悉的路径：开始健康饮食、改善睡眠、进行规律锻炼。
analysis.translationNatural: 人们想改善健康，一般都会走那条老路：吃得健康点、睡得好一点、坚持锻炼。
analysis.structMarkup: {When people set out to improve their health}, 【they】 _usually take_ ~a familiar path~: (starting a healthy diet, getting better sleep, and doing regular exercise).
analysis.structureSummary: 时间状语从句 + 主谓宾 + 冒号后的三项并列补充

components.part: When people set out to improve their health
components.note: set out to do 表「着手做」
take a path 走一条路

components.part: starting a healthy diet, getting better sleep, and doing regular exercise
components.note: 三个动名词短语说明 path 的具体内容

clauses: set out to do sth：着手、开始做某事（比 begin 更有「动身」的意味）。
take a path：走一条路，此处为比喻用法。
冒号后三个动名词并列，解释 path 具体指什么。

phrases.usage: 后接不定式；名词 set out 还可表「出发」。
phrases.example: They set out to change the system. 他们着手改变这套制度。

phrases.usage: path 常作比喻，指「做法、途径」。
phrases.example: He took the familiar path of least resistance. 他走了那条熟悉的省事之路。

phrases.usage: exercise 表「锻炼」时不可数；do exercise 是固定搭配。
phrases.example: Doctors advise doing regular exercise. 医生建议规律锻炼。

pitfalls: set out to do 不能写 set out doing。
exercise 表「锻炼」不可数（表「练习题」才可数）。
冒号后的三个动名词并列，须保持形式一致（都用 -ing）。
analysis.paragraphRole: 开篇列举大众熟悉的健康做法，为后文「漏了社交健康」做铺垫。

sentences.text: Each of these behaviors is important, of course, but they all 26 on physical health—and a growing body of research suggests that social health is just as, if not more, important to 27 well-being.

analysis.translationLiteral: 当然，这些行为每一项都重要，但它们都（26）于身体健康——而越来越多的研究表明，社交健康即使不比身体健康更重要，也同等重要，对（27）幸福感而言。
analysis.translationNatural: 当然，这些行为每一项都重要，但它们都只（26 聚焦）在身体上——而越来越多研究表明，社交健康就算不比身体健康更重要，也同等重要，关系到（27 整体的）幸福感。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Each of these behaviors】 _is_ ~important~, (of course), {but} 【they all _26_ on physical health】—{and} 【a growing body of research】 _suggests_ {that social health is just as, if not more, important to _27_ well-being}.
analysis.structureSummary: 让步性转折并列句 + and 连接的第二个分句（内含宾语从句）

components.note: each of + 复数，谓语用单数 is
of course 作插入语表让步

components.part: but they all 26 on physical health

clauses: each of + 复数名词作主语，谓语用单数（is）。
just as, if not more, important：插入「if not more」表「即使不更……也一样」，是比较结构的难点。
a growing body of research：body of 表「一批、大量」，谓语用单数。
important to sth：对……重要（to 为介词）。

phrases.usage: 26 空答案；focus 可作动词（focus on）或名词（the focus of）。
phrases.example: The campaign focuses on prevention. 这场运动聚焦于预防。

phrases.usage: body of 表「一批」，后接不可数名词，谓语单数。
phrases.example: A growing body of evidence supports this. 越来越多的证据支持这一点。

phrases.text: just as, if not more, important
phrases.meaning: 即使不更重要，也同等重要
phrases.usage: 插入语 if not more 用于加强比较，不改变句子主干。

each of these behaviors 谓语单数 is，不能写 are。
analysis.paragraphRole: 转折句——指出大家只盯着身体，漏掉了社交健康这一同等重要的维度。

paragraphs.text: One recent study published in the journal PLOS ONE, for example, found that the strength of a person's social circle was a better 28 of self-reported stress, happiness and well-being levels than fitness tracker data on physical activity, heart rate and sleep. That finding suggests that the "29 self" represented by endless amounts of health data doesn't tell the whole 30. There's also a qualified self, which is who I am, what are my activities, my social network, and all of these aspects are not 31 in any of these measurements.

sentences.text: One recent study published in the journal PLOS ONE, for example, found that the strength of a person's social circle was a better 28 of self-reported stress, happiness and well-being levels than fitness tracker data on physical activity, heart rate and sleep.

analysis.translationLiteral: 例如，最近发表在《PLOS ONE》期刊上的一项研究发现，一个人社交圈的强度，比健身追踪器上关于身体活动、心率和睡眠的数据，更能（28）自述的压力、幸福感和健康水平。
analysis.translationNatural: 举个例子：最近《PLOS ONE》上的一项研究发现，一个人社交圈有多结实，比健身手环记录的运动、心率、睡眠数据，更能（28 指示）他自己报告的压力、快乐和健康程度。
analysis.structMarkup: (One recent study published in the journal PLOS ONE), (for example), _found_ ~{that the strength of a person's social circle was a better _28_ of self-reported stress, happiness and well-being levels than fitness tracker data on physical activity, heart rate and sleep}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主语（带后置定语）+ 插入语 + 谓语 + that 宾语从句（内含比较结构）

components.part: One recent study published in the journal PLOS ONE
components.note: published... 为过去分词后置定语

components.part: that the strength of a person's social circle was a better 28 of...

components.part: than fitness tracker data on physical activity, heart rate and sleep

clauses: a better 28 of ... than ...：形容词比较级 + than，比较双方是「社交圈强度」与「健身追踪器数据」。
the strength of a person's social circle：社交圈的强度/牢固度。
on physical activity, heart rate and sleep：on 表「关于」，作 data 的后置定语。

phrases.usage: 28 空答案；indicator of 表「……的指示物」。
phrases.example: Test scores are a poor indicator of ability. 考试分数不是能力的可靠指标。

phrases.usage: 复合形容词，指受访者自己填报的数据。
phrases.example: The study used self-reported sleep data. 该研究采用自我报告的睡眠数据。

phrases.usage: tracker 指「追踪设备」；动词 track 表记录。
phrases.example: My fitness tracker says I slept badly. 我的手环显示我睡得不好。

pitfalls: 28 空填名词 indicator（a better indicator of）；不能填 indicate（动词）。
比较双方须平行：the strength of a social circle 对 fitness tracker data。
self-reported 带连字符，作前置定语。
analysis.paragraphRole: 用具体研究支撑上句论断：社交关系比身体数据更能预测健康感受。

sentences.text: That finding suggests that the "29 self" represented by endless amounts of health data doesn't tell the whole 30. There's also a qualified self, which is who I am, what are my activities, my social network, and all of these aspects are not 31 in any of these measurements.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这一发现表明，由无穷无尽的健康数据所代表的「（29）自我」并不能说明全部（30）。还有一个「有资格的自我」，那就是我是谁、我有哪些活动、我的社交网络，而这些方面在这些测量中都没有被（31）。
analysis.translationNatural: 这个发现说明：被无穷健康数据代表的那个「（29 量化）自我」，并不能讲出全部的（30 故事）。还有另一个「有资质的自我」——我是谁、我做什么、我的社交圈，而这些方面在这些测量里全都没被（31 反映）出来。
analysis.structMarkup: 【That finding】 _suggests_ ~{that the "_29_ self" represented by endless amounts of health data doesn't tell the whole _30_}~. 【There】 _is_ ~also a qualified self~, {which is who I am, what are my activities, my social network}, {and} 【all of these aspects】 _are not _31_ in any of these measurements~.
analysis.structureSummary: 第一句：主谓 + that 宾语从句；第二句：there be + which 定语从句 + and 并列分句

components.part: suggests that the "_29_ self" ... doesn't tell the whole _30_
represented by endless amounts of health data
components.note: 过去分词短语修饰 self

components.part: There is also a qualified self
components.note: 还有一个「有资格的自我」

components.part: which is who I am, what are my activities, my social network
components.note: 三个并列成分解释 qualified self

components.part: all of these aspects are not _31_ in any of these measurements

clauses: tell the whole story：讲出全部实情，30 空填 story（固定习语）。
the quantified self：量化自我，指「用数据衡量自己」的概念，29 空填 quantified。
which 引导非限制性定语从句，从句内含三个并列成分（who... / what... / my social network）。
be reflected in：被反映在……中，31 空填 reflected。
not ... in any of：在任何一个……中都不，全否定。

phrases.meaning: 讲出全部实情、说明一切
phrases.usage: 30 空答案；常用于否定句 doesn't tell the whole story。
phrases.example: Numbers don't tell the whole story. 数字说明不了全部问题。

phrases.meaning: 量化自我（用数据记录和衡量自己）
phrases.usage: 29 空答案；quantified 是「量化的」，源自 quantity。
phrases.example: The quantified self movement tracks everything. 「量化自我」运动记录一切。

phrases.usage: 31 空答案；reflect 的被动式。
phrases.example: These values are reflected in the design. 这些价值体现在设计中。

phrases.usage: amounts of + 不可数名词，表大量。
phrases.example: We collect endless amounts of data. 我们收集海量数据。

pitfalls: 29 空填 quantified（过去分词作前置定语），不是 quantity 或 quantify。
30 空填 story，与 tell 构成 tell the whole story，不是 tail 或 storey。
31 空填 reflected（被动），不是 reflect。
qualified self 与 quantified self 仅差几个字母，务必区分。
analysis.paragraphRole: 提出核心概念对立：量化自我 ≠ 完整的自我，社交与身份维度被漏掉。

paragraphs.text: This idea is supported by plenty of 32 research. Studies have shown that social support—whether it comes from friends, family members or a spouse—is 33 associated with better mental and physical health. A rich social life, these studies suggest, can lower stress levels, improve mood, encourage positive health behaviors and discourage damaging ones, boost heart health and improve illness 34 rates.

sentences.text: This idea is supported by plenty of 32 research.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这一观点得到了大量（32）研究的支持。
analysis.translationNatural: 这个说法有大量（32 先前的）研究支撑。
clauses: be supported by：由……支持。
plenty of + 不可数名词：大量……（research 不可数）。
prior research：先前的研究，prior 表「此前的」。

phrases.usage: 常搭 evidence/research/findings。
phrases.example: The theory is supported by data. 该理论有数据支持。

phrases.usage: 32 空答案；prior 表「在前的」，同义 previous/earlier。
phrases.example: Prior research reached similar conclusions. 先前研究得出了类似结论。

pitfalls: 32 空填形容词 prior（prior research），不能填 base 或 eagerly。
research 不可数，不能说 researches（除非指多份具体研究）。
plenty of 可接可数复数也可接不可数。
analysis.paragraphRole: 承上启下：用「大量研究支持」为后文的具体证据开路。

sentences.text: Studies have shown that social support—whether it comes from friends, family members or a spouse—is 33 associated with better mental and physical health.

analysis.translationLiteral: 研究表明，社会支持——无论来自朋友、家人还是配偶——都与更好的心理和身体健康（33）相关。
analysis.translationNatural: 研究显示，社会支持——不管是朋友、家人还是伴侣给的——都和更好的身心健康（33 强烈地）相关。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Studies】 _have shown_ ~{that social support—whether it comes from friends, family members or a spouse—is _33_ associated with better mental and physical health}~.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + that 宾语从句（内含让步状语从句与插入语）

components.part: that social support ... is 33 associated with better mental and physical health
whether it comes from friends, family members or a spouse

clauses: whether it comes from A, B or C：让步状语从句，表「无论来自谁」。
be associated with：与……相关（相关不等于因果）。
strongly associated with：强相关，33 空填副词 strongly 修饰 associated。

phrases.usage: 33 空答案；副词 strongly 修饰过去分词 associated。
phrases.example: Exercise is strongly associated with lower stress. 运动与较低压力密切相关。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，mental 与 physical 并列修饰 health。
phrases.example: Sleep affects both mental and physical health. 睡眠影响身心健康。

analysis.paragraphRole: 引出社会支持与健康的关联证据，支撑「社交影响健康」。

sentences.text: A rich social life, these studies suggest, can lower stress levels, improve mood, encourage positive health behaviors and discourage damaging ones, boost heart health and improve illness 34 rates.

analysis.translationLiteral: 这些研究提示，丰富的社交生活能降低压力水平、改善情绪、鼓励积极的健康行为并抑制有害行为、增进心脏健康，还能提高疾病的（34）率。
analysis.translationNatural: 这些研究说，社交生活丰富的人压力更小、心情更好，更愿意做对健康有益的事、少做伤身的事，心脏更健康，病后（34 康复）率也更高。
analysis.structMarkup: (A rich social life), (these studies suggest), _can_ _lower_ ~stress levels~, _improve_ ~mood~, _encourage_ ~positive health behaviors~ {and} _discourage_ ~damaging ones~, _boost_ ~heart health~ {and} _improve_ ~illness _34_ rates~.
analysis.structureSummary: 插入语 + 主谓 + 五个并列动宾结构

components.note: 主谓插入，等于 as these studies suggest

components.part: can lower / improve / encourage / discourage / boost / improve
components.note: 六个动词共同支配各自宾语

clauses: these studies suggest 作插入语，主句仍是 A rich social life can ...。
多个动词并列，共享情态动词 can。
damaging ones：ones 替代 behaviors，避免重复。
illness recovery rates：疾病康复率，34 空填 recovery。

phrases.usage: 34 空答案；recovery 不可数，rates 用复数表多种疾病。
phrases.example: Social support improves illness recovery rates. 社会支持能提高疾病康复率。

phrases.usage: discourage 表「阻止、使不敢」，反义 encourage。
phrases.example: Taxes can discourage harmful habits. 税收能抑制有害习惯。

phrases.usage: boost 表「提升、促进」。
phrases.example: Walking boosts heart health. 走路有益心脏健康。

pitfalls: 34 空填名词 recovery（recovery rates），不能填 recover。
damaging ones 中的 ones 替代 behaviors，不能换成 ones'。
六个并列动词都在情态动词 can 之后，须用原形。
analysis.paragraphRole: 集中罗列社交生活对健康的多重好处，是「社交有益」的最强证据段。

paragraphs.text: Social isolation, meanwhile, is linked to higher rates of physical diseases and mental health conditions. It's a significant problem, 35 since loneliness is emerging as a widespread public health problem in many countries.

sentences.text: Social isolation, meanwhile, is linked to higher rates of physical diseases and mental health conditions.

analysis.senseInContext: 孤立、隔绝（社会孤立带来更高疾病率）
examples: Social isolation raises the risk of illness. 社会孤立会提高患病风险。

analysis.translationLiteral: 与此同时，社会孤立与更高的身体疾病和心理健康问题发生率相关。
analysis.translationNatural: 反过来，被社会孤立的人，身体生病和心理出问题的比例都更高。
analysis.structMarkup: (Social isolation), (meanwhile), _is linked_ (to higher rates of physical diseases and mental health conditions).

components.part: higher rates of physical diseases and mental health conditions

analysis.paragraphRole: 转向反面证据：孤立带来更高疾病率，形成正反论证。

sentences.text: It's a significant problem, 35 since loneliness is emerging as a widespread public health problem in many countries.

analysis.senseInContext: 显著的、重要的（一个相当严重的问题）
examples: There was a significant drop in cases. 病例显著下降。

analysis.senseInContext: 普遍的、广泛存在的（普遍的公共卫生问题）
examples: The practice is widespread in Asia. 这种做法在亚洲很普遍。

analysis.translationLiteral: 这是一个相当严重的问题，（35）因为孤独在许多国家正成为普遍性的公共卫生问题。

components.part: 35 since loneliness is emerging as a widespread public health problem in many countries

35 空填 especially，与 since 连用构成 especially since（尤其因为）。
emerge as：逐渐成为、显现为（强调过程）。

phrases.usage: 35 空答案；especially 修饰 since 从句，强调原因。
phrases.example: The risk is high, especially since cases are rising. 风险很高，尤其因为病例在增加。

phrases.usage: emerge 表「出现、显露」，as 引出身份。
phrases.example: The city emerged as a tech hub. 这座城市逐渐成为科技中心。

26.reason: 空后紧跟介词 on，且主语 they（这些健康行为）需要一个表示「集中于」的动词原形。focus on physical health＝把重点放在身体健康上，与后文「社交健康同等重要」形成对照。

J puzzle：puzzle on 不成立；puzzle 常作名词「谜」。

E indicator：名词，不能作前置定语修饰 well-being。

28.reason: 句式为 a better __ of self-reported stress...，需一个名词，与 of 搭配表示「……的指标」。indicator of 是学术语境惯用搭配，说明社交圈强度可作为压力与幸福感的预测指标。
distractors: H prior：形容词，不能作名词中心词。
L recovery：名词但语义不符（recovery of stress 不成立）。
M reflected：过去分词，不能直接作 a better __ of 的中心词。

29.reason: the __ self 指「被数据衡量的自我」，与后文 qualified self 形成对照。quantified 意为「量化的」，是「quantified self（量化自我）」这一固定概念，且与 represented by endless amounts of health data 精确对应。
distractors: M reflected：the reflected self 不构成固定概念，且与后文 qualified self 不形成对照。
O strongly：副词不能作前置定语。
